summary: Standard-table serialization ignored the dotted flag on nested inline tables, emitting src = { git = ... } instead of src.git = .... The fix recursively collects dotted inline-table values with their parent key path. The selected integration test was added by this fix in tests/test_edit.rs. The reversal restores only the original value-handling branch; both source regions occur exactly once. No builds or tests were run.
expected_failure: Display equality assertion fails: expected src.git = "https://github.com/nixos/nixpkgs", but actual output serializes src as a braced inline table.
